ReconciliationAnalysis.MicrobenchmarkVsWorkloadExplanation: The microbenchmark accessed the full 50M range uniformly using prime stride 7919, causing frequent buffer cache misses and higher latency (~1,096 us p50). The workload benchmark used a Zipfian distribution where 85% of queries hit the 1% hot set (15.75 MB), which fit entirely in PostgreSQL shared_buffers (~583 us p50).
